tools.name: todo_list
tools.description: Manages a personal todo list. Use this to add, view, complete, or delete tasks for the user.

functions.name: add_todo
functions.description: Adds a new task to the todo list

date.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

functions.name: view_todos
functions.description: Shows all tasks in the todo list

functions.name: get_todo
functions.description: Reads a single task by its ID

functions.name: complete_todo
functions.description: Marks a task as done by its ID

todo_id.description: The ID of the task to complete

functions.name: delete_todo
functions.description: Deletes a task by its ID

todo_id.description: The ID of the task to delete
